versions.provenance: Lugano Classification for evaluation and staging of Hodgkin and Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (incorporating Ann Arbor with Cotswolds modifications); licensed clinical reference.
versions.introduction: Lymphoma staging uses the Lugano Classification, adapted from the Ann Arbor system with Cotswolds modifications. Staging reflects anatomical nodal distribution across the diaphragm, contiguous or non-contiguous extralymphatic organ involvement (E), spleen involvement (S), bulky disease (X), and systemic B-symptoms (fever, drenching night sweats, weight loss). Fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) PET-CT is the standard imaging modality.

t.label: Involvement of a single lymph node region (I) or localized involvement of a single extralymphatic site in absence of nodal involvement (IE)
Involvement of two or more lymph node regions on the SAME side of the diaphragm (II), or localized contiguous extralymphatic site with regional nodes on the same side (IIE)
Involvement of lymph node regions on BOTH sides of the diaphragm (III), optionally involving spleen (IIIS)
Multifocal or diffuse involvement of one or more extralymphatic organs (e.g., bone marrow, liver, lung, pleura, CSF) with or without associated nodal disease

n.label: Absence of constitutional systemic B symptoms
Presence of B symptoms: unexplained fever >38C, drenching night sweats, or unexplained weight loss >10% of body weight over 6 months

m.label: Single mass >= 10 cm in diameter OR mediastinal mass occupying > 1/3 of the maximum transthoracic diameter on chest radiograph

stageGroups.t: Single node region or single IE site
stageGroups.basis: Limited stage disease. Potential candidate for abbreviated chemo + involved-site radiation (ISRT) in Hodgkin, or R-CHOP x3-4 + ISRT in aggressive NHL.
Bulky localized lymphoma requiring full systemic therapy cycles.

stageGroups.t: >=2 node regions on SAME side of diaphragm
stageGroups.basis: Limited stage disease if non-bulky and without adverse features.

stageGroups.t: >=2 node regions on SAME side of diaphragm
stageGroups.basis: Treated as advanced-stage disease in most modern protocols.

stageGroups.t: Node regions on BOTH sides of diaphragm
stageGroups.basis: Advanced-stage lymphoma requiring full systemic immunochemotherapy (e.g. 6 cycles R-CHOP or Pola-R-CHP for DLBCL; A+AVD or ABVD for Hodgkin).
Advanced-stage lymphoma requiring full systemic therapy; CNS prophylaxis evaluation indicated in high-risk DLBCL.

versions.regionalNodes: Lymph node chains: cervical, supraclavicular, axillary, mediastinal, hilar, mesenteric, para-aortic, iliac, inguinal. Waldeyer ring and spleen are considered lymphatic tissue.
versions.histologicGrade: Defined by WHO/ICC classification (e.g. FL Grade 1-3A vs 3B; DLBCL COO by Hans algorithm ABC/non-GCB vs GCB).
versions.histopathologicTypes: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), Follicular lymphoma, Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (nodular sclerosis, mixed cellularity, lymphocyte-rich, lymphocyte-depleted), Mantle cell lymphoma, Marginal zone lymphoma, T-cell lymphomas.
prognosticFactors: International Prognostic Index (IPI / R-IPI) for DLBCL: Age >60, Stage III-IV, elevated LDH, ECOG PS >=2, >1 extranodal site
FLIPI for Follicular Lymphoma: Age >=60, Stage III-IV, Hb <12 g/dL, >4 nodal areas, elevated serum LDH
IPS for Advanced Hodgkin Lymphoma: Albumin <4 g/dL, Hb <10.5 g/dL, Male, Stage IV, Age >=45, WBC >=15,000/mcL, Lymphocytes <600/mcL
Double-hit / Triple-hit biology: MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 gene rearrangements
PET-CT response by Deauville 5-point scale (Lugano response criteria)
